name: Terroir Atlas
description: An open cartographic page with a broad contour-map crest, an offset title and three coloured vineyard coordinates.

name: Decanter Study
description: A curving, wide-bottomed frame holds a single portrait beside a tall heading, opening into a spacious reading bowl.

name: Tannin & Time
description: Two tall portraits form an asymmetric diptych above a strong horizontal title and a slim coloured margin rail.

name: The Lees
description: A spare typographic page with an oversized low-set heading, generous paragraph space and a stippled sediment base.

name: Véraison
description: A diagonal vineyard trellis frames two curved portraits over a colour-block name ribbon and airy full-width prose.

name: Sommelier OS
description: A tailored smartphone with a pill camera, a small circular contact portrait and a framed conversation screen.

name: Corkline
description: A notification-style phone with a large lock-screen clock, compact contact label and individually outlined message cards.

name: Claret Connect
description: A tall phone with a panoramic contact-photo header, a colour-washed name strip and rounded received bubbles.

name: Amphora Link
description: A broad foldable messenger with twin portrait tiles, a centre hinge seam and softly squared message bubbles.

name: Vintner Touch
description: A slim corner-cut smartphone with a fine illuminated edge, a bottom contact dock and square inset message bubbles.

name: Pipette
description: A narrow miniature reply with a tall glass-tube portrait and a small drop of colour beside the writing.

name: Winefoil
description: A compact bottle-foil sleeve with a serrated top edge, a narrow name band and a softly slanted title.

name: Two Sips
description: Two small bowl-shaped portraits sit above a shared stem line and a centred miniature reply.

name: Corklet
description: A horizontal cellar-tag note with a punched loop, inked edge and a compact left-aligned reply.

name: Rimprint
description: A small open note with a ring-framed portrait overlapping a partial glass-rim impression and fine coloured rules.
